description: This file defines the RAGQuery class which provides static methods for processing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) operations, such as extracting queries from messages, building context messages, adding search results to responses, and extracting documents from search responses.

classes.name: RAGQuery
classes.description: A utility class that offers static methods for handling retriever-augmented generation (RAG) tasks such as extracting queries, building context messages, and integrating search results into responses.

methods.name: Optional[str] extract_query_from_messages(messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Extracts a query string from a list of message dictionaries, specifically from the last user message.

methods.name: ChatCompletionUserMessage build_context_message(context_chunks: List[Any])
methods.description: Creates a user message with context by concatenating content from search result chunks.

methods.name: ModelResponse add_search_results_to_response( response: ModelResponse, search_results: VectorStoreSearchResponse, rerank_results: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Incorporates search results and rerank results into the provider-specific fields of a ModelResponse object.

methods.name: List[Union[str,Dict[str,Any]]] extract_documents_from_search( search_response: Any, )
methods.description: Extracts text documents from a search response data structure.

methods.name: List[Any] get_top_chunks_from_rerank(search_response: Any, rerank_response: Any)
methods.description: Retrieves the original search result chunks corresponding to the top reranked results.

ctags.name: add_search_results_to_response
ctags.signature: ( response: ModelResponse, search_results: VectorStoreSearchResponse, rerank_results: Optional[Any] = None, )
